Sida loo rakibo

  1. Riix APK-ga kore, faylka u guuri telefoonka.
  2. Fur faylka → Android waxa uu weydiinayaa "Install unknown apps" → u oggolow.
  3. Riix Install. Play Protect waxa laga yaabaa inuu digniin muujiyo — APK-gu wuxuu ku saxeexan yahay debug key, taasi waa caadi nooca tijaabada.

Xusuusnow: noocan Bluetooth ma laha (plugin-ka radio waa EP-03). Fariin kastaa waxay ku hadhaa safka queued, oo shaashaddu waxay leedahay "Waiting for Axmed's phone". Taasi waa runta, ma aha bug.
